deps: bun add -d --exact typescript oxlint oxlint-tsgolint oxfmt fallow

check: bunx fallow dead-code || { echo 'Unused code: delete it, or import it from an entry point if it is meant to be used.'; exit 1; }
bunx fallow dupes --threshold 0.01 || { echo 'Duplicated code: extract it into one shared function and reuse it.'; exit 1; }
